description: This file defines a Java interface repository for accessing GroupLoanIndividualMonitoringAccount entities, using Spring Data JPA. It provides methods for querying accounts based on certain attributes.

classes.name: GLIMAccountInfoRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for GroupLoanIndividualMonitoringAccount entities, supporting CRUD and specification executor functionality.

methods.name: findOneByIsAcceptingChild
methods.description: Finds an account where the acceptingChild flag matches the given boolean value.

methods.name: findOneByIsAcceptingChildAndApplicationId
methods.description: Finds an account where the acceptingChild flag and application ID match the given parameters.

methods.name: findOneByAccountNumber
methods.description: Finds an account with the specified account number.
